buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Participating traders/agents must provide authorization letter issued by the OEM. Authorization letter sh ould be tender/Bid specific. Bidders must submit valid authorization letter containing the required informat ion along with their offer failing which Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. 2. For placement of order, the OEM [Principal Firm] directly or through authorized dealers shall have succe ssfully executed a contract for COMPUTER of any Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project of minimum 20 percen t of the advertised value of the bid during previous 5 years. This period of 5 years shall be counted with res pect to date of tender closing. Supplied COMPUTER must have satisfactorily completed minimum 12 mont hs in service. In this regard, Firms should submit a performance certificate issued by competent authority of that Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project containing details as mentioned in the Annexure -“Performance Certificate Format” attached with the tender. Failure to submit documentary evidencei the required format will imply that firm has no such performance and Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. In cas e tenderer participates as an authorized agent, then the performance as required above shall be that of th e principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past supply for a diffe rent Principal, but these will not be considered as performance for placing the order in case of change of Pr incipal 4. At-least one OEM Authorised service centre should be located in Nagpur city. Complete Address & Phon e numbers of a functional OEM authorised service centre in Nagpur city to be pr ovided by the bidder on O EM letter head failing which Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. 5. Warranty Period shall be minimum As per GeM Bid specification on as per OEMs specification whichever is higher. Tender/Bid specific warranty period certificate confirmed by the OEM on its letterhead to be sub mitted along with the offer failing which Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. OEM warranty c ertificates must also be submitted at the time of delivery of Goods. 6. Bidders must attach a bid specific undertaking strictly containing all the details required as per the Anne xure - "Undertaking Format" attached with the tender. In cases where the bidder has never been under sus pension/De-listing/Debarment/De-registration/Blacklisting by GeM / Government departments / Public sect or undertaking / Private Sector, Period shall be shown as “Nil” in then given format. Undertaking must cont ain the Name & Designation along with contact details [Phone No./Official Email id] of the signatory for vali dation purpose. Failure to submit this document in the required format/unfilled parameters may lead to rej ection of the offer. 7. Bidder must submit a certificate issued by the OEM on its letterhead strictly containing all the details as mentioned in the Annexure – “Product Details” attached with the tender. In cases where there is no techni cal deviation, “Nil” must be mentioned in the Deviation table of the Annexure – “Product Details”. Failure t o submit this certificate in the required format/unfilled parameters may lead to rejection of the offer. No fu

rther claim of the bidder will be admissible in such cases. 8. Bidders must attach only relevant documents required to be submitted as per the tender conditions/crit eria and upload such documents strictly under the appropriate fields/headers given. Documents/credential s requested under para "Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC" must be mandatorily uploaded under the header " Certificate (Requested in ATC)". For the purpose of offer evaluation, Railway reserves the right to ignore a ny such documents which have been uploaded under inappropriate fields/headers [For example: Documen ts requested under para "Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC" if uploaded under MSE category or MII documento r any header other than "Certificate (Requested in ATC)" may get ignored for evaluation]. No claim/repres entation of the bidder shall be admissible in such cases. 9. Railway reserves the right to ignore offer of any such bidder who has faced cancellation/termination of c ontract with imposition of penalty/incident on account of unsatisfactory performance/execution of contra ct of any equivalent services/goods during the past 12 months. This period of 12 months shall be counted wit h respect to date of tender closing. 10. Railway reserves the right to validate authenticity of any document submitted by the bidder from its is s uing authority. Contact details [Name/Designation/Official email/Mobile no.] of the issuing authority must b e provided by the bidder if asked for, failing which Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. 11. Bidder is mandate to submit Annexure I attached in this bid. 12.In case of non submission of requisite credentials. The offer will be rejected and no representation or cl aim will be entertained in this regard. 13. Contract shall be governed by IRS conditions of contract. . 3.
